changes: Global: (Bugfix) The memory patch that allows cutscenes to be skipped is now only applied when a skip category actually applies to the cutscene. It will no longer cause first-time cutscene views to be skipped with no relevant skip active.
Global: (Bugfix) Auto-Party Mode now fully resets its internal state on plugin load, and after a session ends so that no bad config remains after force-closed session or a crash.
Behaviour: Added a new Behaviour category with an opt-in toggle for players who want to skip first-time cutscene views everywhere in the game. This is disabled by default.
Commands: Removed the /sc sanity check command due to not being needed anymore.
IPC: Added AllowCutsceneSeenGlobally to GetSkippedCategories and GetConfig.
